name: Loop build and release
lesson:
## Halve the loop, double the tension

At bar 9 set a 4-beat loop, then re-set it at 2 beats, 1 beat, then half a beat, and exit exactly on bar 17. Map "Loop A" to your loop-in or the 4-beat auto-loop button and "Loop out" to the out/exit button; on the FLX4, the auto-loop halve button also works if you prefer.

This is a manual build. Do it into a breakdown or over the last 8 bars before a drop.

tracks.cue: On the build: 4-beat loop at bar 9, halve to 2, 1, half, exit exactly on the drop at bar 17.
The bars before the riff returns after the breakdown: loop-halve into the riff entry.
